question: Which action did the Civil Disobedience Movement start?

options.text: Arrest of Jawaharlal Nehru and Abdul Ghaffar Khan

solution:
The correct answer is __**Dandi March**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Dandi March, also known as the Salt March, was initiated by Mahatma Gandhi on March 12, 1930.
 
• This march was a direct action campaign of tax resistance and nonviolent protest against the British salt monopoly.
 
• The march lasted from March 12 to April 6, covering a distance of 240 miles (390 km) from Sabarmati Ashram to Dandi, a coastal village in Gujarat.
